what: Minecraft's custom model data as the selector of an item.presentation@1 StackPresenter: from 1.21.4 the first string of the minecraft:custom_model_data record, which the generated item definition selects on (item-definition); before it the locked number, which the generated item model's overrides test, in the stack's root tag before 1.20.5 and in the component of that name from it (model-overrides). It writes the selector onto a stack and into the raw item data a display entity is built from, and loads the generated plan. Which model a stack draws is the plan's.

overlays.why: a stack's state became components: custom model data is the component minecraft:custom_model_data, a record of one number, and raw item data keeps it under components
